title: Shiraishi An — A Bit Of Frustration〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whew!
The event Len and the others did was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We even got to jump in partway through.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. At the same time, I was impressed by how they started everything off with a powerful song and never let that energy fade.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Not only that, we got to see KAITO actually DJ for the first time in a while.
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, let's go! We're next!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay!
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! A duet with Luka and MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow...! This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. We're just getting started.
KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay!
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was so awesome.
Aren't events just the best?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Guys, when do you think we should do our next one?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Slow down. We haven't even done the debrief for our first one yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that's all a part of making our next one better, right? What's wrong with getting a little head start?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see your point... On top of this being the first event we've ever put on, we achieved some good results.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It may be good for us to keep accrue as much experience as we can while we still have this feeling fresh in our minds.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we're definitely gonna need more experience moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Plus, we're gonna need to see what kind of atmosphere we can produce and how much we can get the crowd going next time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's still a lot of stuff that we still need to test out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you're also pretty excited about our next event, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Talk about getting ahead of yourself!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says the one who initially brought it up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It really is great to have teammates like you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're saying this now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because it's important to me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Vivid Street went pretty wild after RAD WEEKEND happened. For a good while too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You couldn't take three steps without seeing musicians try to flex their muscles and out-sing everyone else...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You probably know what I'm talking about, Akito. Remember what it was like back then?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But things like COL closing down and Ken announcing his retirement sort of put a damper on all that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Even though everyone was saying, “I'm gonna do that next,” right after that event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As RAD WEEKEND became more and more legendary, the number of people trying to surpass it just kept shrinking.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why I'm really glad that I found teammates who are actually serious about surpassing it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And it's not just anymore. We have Arata, Kotaro and everyone from EVER now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've gotta think it's pretty rare to see so many people chasing after the same exact dream like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we're blessed to have such good friends.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right?!
That's why we should do our next event soon!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How exactly did you arrive on that?
You're talking about two completely different things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! You said it yourself, Akito. There's still a lot of stuff we need to test out, right?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In any case, we'll need to do the debrief for this event first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right! I'll send everyone from EVER and the others a message to see when would be best!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look, we need to sit down and have a long discussion, so make it a Saturday or Sunday, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, got it.
I'll start by asking which days work for everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you guys need to tell me when you're free too! I'll plan and adjust around that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
